{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Anakin Skywalker?'' Is that really you?''"<br />"''Yes, it's ''really'' me! But I don't think it's ''really'' you, Senator.|Eirtaé and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="In Triplicate">{{TCWComicCite|6.3|In Triplicate}}</ref>}}
'''Eirtaé''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as one of the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]] of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she was [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
[[File:Handmaiden_training.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Eirtaé evades stun blasts during [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka's]] handmaiden training.]]
Eirtaé was brought up as a wealthy girl in a remote [[river]] valley of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWTCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

She was the only applicant for the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] who had [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] in contrast to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] brown hair and brown eyes.<ref name="TPM" />

Eirtaé and the other handmaidens were trained in self-defense and marksmanship by Amidala's head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]].<ref name="QoD">''[[Queen in Disguise]]''</ref> She particularly excelled in dealing with protocol<ref name="SWTCVD" /> and spotting treachery. However, she was less skilled in martial arts than the other handmaidens.<ref name="SON" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Eirtaé was one of the three handmaidens who accompanied Amidala to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Naboo. At the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], she helped to end the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion on Naboo]], and was present at the [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and the [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|celebration]] following the next [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="TPM" />

===Later career===
{{Dialogue|Skywalker|In fact, I'm pretty sure it's&hellip; Amidala's ''decoys''&mdash;Sabé&mdash;and Eritaé. ''[sic]''<nowiki></nowiki>|Eirtaé|Actually, I'm Eritaé! ''[sic]''<nowiki></nowiki>|Sabé|And I'm Sabé!||attr=[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], unable to distinguish between [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]] and Eirtaé|src=<ref name="In Triplicate" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] discovered that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had paid several outlaws on Coruscant to kidnap Amidala before a crucial speech in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. In an effort to draw out the kidnappers, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hid Amidala in a safe location and allowed [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]] and Eirtaé to be [[Attempted kidnapping of Senator Amidala|captured]] instead. The Council then sent [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and, secretly, Amidala's [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|husband]]&mdash;to rescue the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]; Skywalker was not aware of the exchange that had occurred. Skywalker successfully tracked down the kidnappers and subdued them. He released Amidala's decoys, but did not like that he was not told the truth about the Jedi Council's plans.<ref name="In Triplicate" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Eirtae1.png|thumb|210px|Eirtaé with Padmé Amidala and Captain Panaka during the Second Battle of Theed]]
Eirtaé was portrayed by [[Liz Wilson|Friday "Liz" Wilson]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" />

In the children's book ''[[Queen in Disguise]]'', Eirtaé's hair was erroneously colored brown,<ref name="QoD" /> while in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story ''[[In Triplicate]]'', her name was misspelled as "Eritaé."<ref name="In Triplicate" />

Eirtaé was cut from the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Eirtaé and four other Queen Amidala's handmaidens — [[Rabé/Legends|Rabé]], [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], [[Saché/Legends|Saché]] and [[Yané/Legends|Yané]] — were intended to be introduced in the game with the [[2005]] "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]." They would have been featured in a quest named "Helping the Handmaidens," included in the Naboo part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the longest questline in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
